questions.q:
The state of a substance whether it will be solid, liquid or gas is determined by:

a. Temperature
b. Pressure
c. Volume
questions.explain: The physical state of a substance depends on two primary factors: temperature and pressure, which dictate the kinetic energy of particles and the intermolecular forces holding them together.
